sections.excerpt:

well as the other information we have provided in this prospectus before you decide to invest in our common stock. If any of the following risks are realized, in whole or in part, our business, financial condition, operating results and prospects
could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the price of our common stock could decline, and you could lose part or all of your investment. The risks described are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not

sections.title: Dividend Policy
sections.excerpt:
Dividend policy In connection with this offering, we will adopt a dividend policy approved by Barrick, pursuant to which we expect to pay an annualized base dividend of $1.25 billion, paid on a quarterly basis. In addition, after reinvesting in our Tier
One assets and pursuing growth opportunities, we also expect to return free cash flow in excess of our target net cash position of $1.0 billion (plus or minus $2.0 billion) to stockholders through special dividends subject to the discretion of
